column1: # Preferred Britfone variant (1-based, Britfone's numbering) for words whose first
# variant is not the one passages should expect. Read by tools/content/lexicon.py and
# baked into assets/content/britfone.v1.tsv (preferred variant first), so the app's
# lookup() uses the same choice.
# Weak forms stay the default for most function words (a, an, and, at, can, for, of,
# the, to, was, ...); these are exceptions where the weak form is often wrong (lexical
# "have", demonstrative "that") or very reduced for learners.
you       3   # j uː: weak "jə" is too reduced to score fairly
your      3   # j ɔː: modern SSBE
him       2   # h ɪ m: keep the h
have      2   # lexical "have" is common; strong form is never wrong
has       2
had       2
that      2   # demonstrative "that" is strong
isn't     2   # negative contractions are stressed
use       2   # verb (j uː z); noun uses were reworded in the passages
close     2   # verb (k l əʊ z)
separate  3   # verb (s ɛ p ə ɹ eɪ t)
just      2   # strong form: "just" is often stressed
sometimes 2   # s ʌ m t aɪ m z
contact   2   # British verb and noun: k ɒ n t æ k t
contract  2   # noun
content   2   # noun
survey    2   # noun
surveys   2
subjects  2   # noun
transport 2   # noun
